claims.statement: Session bundles are temporary working memory stored repo-local under .agents/sessions/; they are immutable after closeout except for status/distillation-related fields in summary.json, and only promoted lessons become durable under .agents/ (prescriptive) or openwiki/ (descriptive).

The canonical task/session identifier is the task_id field inside .agents/sessions/<folder>/summary.json, not the folder name; the folder name YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-short-topic is only a sortable storage label, one bundle per folder, with repo_id providing stable project context.

.agents/.gitignore uses sessions/* paired with !sessions/README.md (relative to .agents/) so every per-task subfolder is ignored and only .agents/sessions/README.md is tracked; initialization merges these lines idempotently and falls back to .agents/sessions/* and !.agents/sessions/README.md in root .gitignore when .agents/.gitignore is not tracked.

Each session folder must contain exactly five files — summary.json, active-task.md, learning-candidate.md, changed-files.txt, validation.txt — where summary.json requires task_id and optionally carries repo_id, agent, agent_session_id, openspec_change, git metadata and distilled/distillation_status; task-closeout is the sole writer of this tree and never edits openwiki/**, .agents/AGENTS.md, .agents/playbooks/**, .agents/skills/** or openspec/ for in-flight changes.

summary.json may contain an optional prior_session string pointing to an earlier bundle directory to chain related closeouts without merging folders; earlier packets stay append-only and distillation merges lessons using task_id, timestamps and prior_session.

Because bundle folders are gitignored, discovery must use ignore-blind methods (filesystem ls/find or rg --no-ignore-vcs / --no-ignore) and then read task_id from summary.json to filter by distilled/status/distillation_status; ignore-aware glob/search must not be used to conclude no bundles exist.

Agent provenance fields agent and agent_session_id are optional and independent in summary.json (mirrored as Agent / Agent Session ID sections in active-task.md); they are recorded only when the active tool supplies them and must never be invented.

When a session worked on an OpenSpec change its name is recorded in summary.json openspec_change; closeout never edits openspec/ for in-flight changes and defers spec updates to /opsx:archive time, with the deferral noted in learning-candidate.md.

Proposal add-task-start defines task-start as creation-only (creates .agents/sessions/YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-short-topic/, ensures README/.gitignore, seeds summary.json with canonical task_id, created_at, status in_progress and optional openspec_change/repo_id/agent) and task-closeout as finalization-only (preserves task_id and openspec_change, appends completed_at, final status and remaining bundle files); no durable writes occur at start/closeout, sequencing is strictly start → work → closeout → distill with summary.json as single source of truth and fallback generation when no seed exists, and until archived the enforced lifecycle remains work → closeout → distill.

.openwikiignore provides defense-in-depth beyond git by listing .agents/sessions/ with negation !.agents/sessions/README.md (and anchored /example/) so bundles under .agents/sessions/ are excluded from openwiki --update fingerprinting and cannot be cited as repo:// evidence — only .agents/sessions/README.md remains citable.
